svg.metadata: {"story":"Moses","act":1,"chapter":"Ch.1 · The Child in the River","scene":"C","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"The mother hides the child for three months, then sets him in a basket of bulrushes among the reeds, where Pharaoh's daughter finds him.
